_source: Return reason codes. Verified 2026-10-14 against the PRIMARY documents: RBI/NPCI CTS Specifications for Continuous Clearing, Rev 3.0 (26 Mar 2025) (Appendix DD, section 4.5.3.3.1; the file in docs/npci/source is byte-identical under two names, one of which wrongly says v2.10) and the Chennai Bankers' Clearing House CTS Procedural Guidelines v2.1 (Jul 2018). Customer-not-at-fault flags (Annexure II) come from a bank's policy reproducing URRBCH Annexure D; they are NOT in the two primary documents.

_numbering_note: The 2018 Chennai guideline numbers the RBI/government group 69-75 (Advice not received = 69). The CURRENT CHI spec Rev 3.0 and this master use 70-76. Always use the numbering of the specification version NGCH is running.
_file_format: ReturnReason is a numeric string, min 2 / max 3 characters (CHI spec Rev 3.0); the spec's table prints codes 1-5 without a leading zero, its file examples use '01'. Code 99 'Deemed Accepted' is assigned by the clearing house when no response arrives; a drawee bank must not send it.
_comment_rules: For code 88, ReturnReasonComment must be non-empty, must not start with a digit, and must not start with a space or consist only of spaces (CHI spec Rev 3.0 section 4.5.3.3 / RRF attribute table).
